why_this_is_the_right_file: the embedded path reads Creatures\PC\Hero_00_Body.mif, which names the player character body mesh, and pc/hero_00.msh is the name table entry at the same index

file_entry_layout.Archive+0x40: array of 64-byte entries, indexed by file index
file_entry_layout.entry+0x04: u32 data offset in the archive
file_entry_layout.entry+0x20: pointer to the name buffer at runtime
file_entry_layout.entry+0x2C: name length field (reads 0 in the live dump; the real name buffer is at +0x38)

block_header: u16 payloadLength, 3-byte magic MSH/ANM/TEX, u8 version, u32 zero, u32 pathLength, u32 dataLength, then the path string terminated by 0x0D
method_note: The file table in memory, not the on-disk 12-byte block table, is the authoritative index: the on-disk block table is ordered by offset and does not line up with name order, which is why my earlier attempts with it picked the wrong block.
not_yet: the payload after the path is still not decoded; no zlib stream was found in a sample block, so the encoding remains unknown
